research_notes: Initial research 1 October 2026. Official extract, first speech, contemporary conference biography, employer publication, Treasury participant list, union amalgamation release and contemporary InDaily reporting examined.

Education remains separate: Diploma in Media Communications (London College of Printing), Master of Business (Southern Cross University), and doctoral studies current in July 2010; no completion or employment inference from study. Dates and study/work overlaps need evidence.

Early employers, UK employment, unidentified private/government/community senior posts described in conference biography, CLC role and period, UniSA endpoints/control, and advisory memberships remain incomplete. Preserve these gaps rather than declare exhaustive career coverage.

Public LinkedIn profile indexed at https://au.linkedin.com/in/karen-grogan-8a3434114 adds SACOSS dates already in official material; no additional authenticated content used. Searches for UniSA annual reports and CLC historical appointments did not establish individual endpoints. Exclude US university, Canadian accounting and poultry-veterinary namesakes.

First speech explicitly describes an interruption in contract work around 1994, but no return date or duration. Do not infer uninterrupted employment between other roles. No full-time fraction established; seniority, month dates and nominal continuity do not prove it.

Follow up historical UniSA and CLC staff/annual reports, early employer identification, full-time or part-time evidence, leave, ACOSS/government advisory tenure and pay, and precise union payroll transition. All excluded roles kept separate; unknown employment is not zero.

Follow-up2026-10-02: UniSA professional-profile months and interim College head identified, with April2010 university corroboration. September–October2010 overlap with Butler office retained for reconciliation; hours and university historical control remain unknown.

February2023 Senate testimony adds ATSIS employment and CDEP operations management, which may be the same spell. Public ATSIS control supported by contemporary ANAO agency audit. Ten years NT/two years CLC are rounded recollections, not calculable FT intervals.

Searches for CLC role, ATSIS/CDEP title and earlier employers did not resolve endpoints/hours. UK/US namesake profiles excluded; no PhD completion inferred. Direct LinkedIn999 was a source access gap, not a terminal research error.

Follow-up2026-10-03: exact-name CLC, ATSIS, CDEP and AliceSprings searches returned only her existing first-person accounts and current party biography. The2023Senate wording calls her the last-standing CDEP operations manager after separately saying she worked for ATSIS; it still does not conclusively establish whether ATSIS was the payroll entity for that function or provide dates/hours. CDEP program-history sources describe policy milestones but were not used as personal employment endpoints. No new employer or interval added.
